capabilities: Convert canvas cards into task cards with completion indicators
Assign card types (Task, Question, Important, Idea, Info) and priority levels
Manage subtasks with progress bars and auto-complete
Filter visible cards by type or priority
Customize colors, indicator size, animations, and completed opacity
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it requires Obsidian v1.5.0+ and also supports BRAT installation.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns Canvas cards into task cards with completion states, card types, and priority levels.
problem: Obsidian Canvas cards have no built-in way to track completion status, priority, or subtask progress on the board.

relations.evidence: Works alongside Advanced Canvas — both plugins' controls coexist in the popup toolbar

summary: Canvas extension that turns canvas cards into task cards with completion states, card types, priority levels, subtasks, and filters.
